banner.title: wizarr
banner.tagline: Issues Plex invite links to friends, and seeds its admin, Plex server and Seerr rows from GitOps secrets on every start.

explainer.title: Generate once, seed on boot, invite through join

steps.title: Generate
steps.text: The Password generator makes the admin password and the Wizarr API key once. PushSecret records both in 1Password item wizarr.
steps.scene: two keys cut from a single block

steps.title: Seed
steps.text: An init container runs the database upgrade, then seed.py. It writes the admin, the Plex server, the Seerr connection and the hermes API key.
steps.scene: a database cylinder being filled with glowing rows

steps.title: Admin
steps.text: wizarr.${SECRET_DOMAIN} on envoy-internal serves the admin UI and the health check to LAN and VPN clients only.
steps.scene: an admin panel on a glowing monitor

steps.title: Join
steps.text: join.${SECRET_DOMAIN} on envoy-external routes only the invite paths and /favicon.ico. Every other path on that host is not routed.
steps.scene: a door opening onto an invitation card

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: kopiur snapshots the 1 GiB SQLite claim to R2 each day. Invites and libraries live in that database.
steps.scene: a small database cylinder flowing into a cloud
